$comment: Workspace for `cairn doctor`. Repos listed here are compared against each other. Per-repo settings (tracker, stack, agent names) belong in each repo's own cairn.config.json — an entry here only needs name, path and stack. An inline `vars` block is a fallback used only for a repo that has not been through `cairn init` yet. charityiq-app/ and snap-proof/ each carry their own repos.json too (the sibling list rendered into their AGENTS.md); this one spans all of them for doctor.

shared.note: Command stubs — should be identical modulo vars. Rendered from workflow config in v2.
Replaced by the vendored cairn shim — this rule now guards against a copy creeping back.
AGENTS.md / JIRA_MARKUP.md / WORKFLOW.md. INITIAL_PROMPT.md is excluded on purpose: four variants, 0% shared — it is a per-project document, not a drifted template.
Role contract is shareable within a stack; persona body is not.
Project-owned. Compared for visibility only — cairn will never generate this.

normalize.$comment: vars listed here are folded to {{placeholders}} before comparing, so stack-specific naming stops counting as drift. What survives folding is the real divergence.
